name: xmemory-ai__xmemory-admin
description: Control plane for xmemory — create, list, inspect, and delete memory instances and generate their schemas. Instance management only: admin connections cannot read or write the data inside instances (use the main xmemory server for that). Includes destructive operations such as deleting an instance — use with care.

oauth_config.name: xmemory Admin MCP
oauth_config.description: xmemory admin MCP server (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, dynamic client registration)

tools.name: admin_generate_schema
tools.description: Generate a YAML schema from free-form text via LLM

tools.name: admin_enhance_schema
tools.description: Improve an existing YAML schema based on a text description

tools.name: admin_list_clusters
tools.description: List clusters accessible to the caller

tools.name: admin_get_cluster
tools.description: Get a single cluster by ID

tools.name: admin_delete_instance
tools.description: Permanently delete an instance — cannot be undone

tools.name: admin_list_own_instances
tools.description: List all instances across linked clusters

tools.name: admin_get_instance_by_id
tools.description: Get an instance by ID (resolves its cluster)

tools.name: admin_delete_instance_by_id
tools.description: Permanently delete an instance by ID — cannot be undone

tools.name: admin_get_instance_schema_by_id
tools.description: Get a schema by instance ID (read-only fleet observability)

tools.name: admin_update_instance_metadata_by_id
tools.description: Update instance metadata by instance ID

tools.name: admin_patch_instance_metadata_by_id
tools.description: Patch instance metadata by instance ID
